description: Holds an incoming reset back until the next clock pulse, so that a sequencer restarts in step with the rest of the patch

inputs.text: The clock pulse; it passes through to the CLK output, and a reset being held is released the moment a pulse arrives here
A reset arriving while the clock input is at 0V is held until the next clock pulse; one arriving while the clock input is above 0V goes out at once

outputs.text: Carries the clock input unchanged, unless No CLK on Reset is turned on, in which case it holds 0V from the reset pulse until the next clock pulse arrives
A 10V pulse carrying the reset, timed to land with a clock pulse

notes: the green lamp follows the clock input and the yellow lamp shows a reset being held back for the next clock pulse
a reset that arrives while the clock input is at 0V is held until a clock pulse arrives at CLK, so with no clock patched there a held reset never reaches the RESET output
shift-dragging up or down on the module name changes the colour of the panel, and holding ctrl as well makes the change finer
menu: No CLK on Reset — holds the CLK output at 0V while a reset pulse is going out, for sequencers such as SS-1 and SS-2 that misread a clock and a reset arriving together
